propositions: T5c security findings are evaluated against the spec text only (via shared preamble), but LLM security tools ground exploitability in the current codebase and configuration; 46% of strong T5c findings already cite repo artifacts despite the as-written stance, indicating a mismatch requiring a criterion-local grounding override.

T5c emits multiple findings for the same undeclared-access-posture template shape (one per surface), causing template-shape findings to displace other criteria in advisory-cap-limited reviews; dedup-at-source must cap undeclared findings at one per plan with additional surfaces folded into evidence.

Ungrounded T5c findings that cite neither a read repo artifact nor a quoted plan sentence must be demoted to MINOR severity to avoid blocking on pure template shapes; existing grounded findings retain full strength.

T5c routing must shift from advisory@0.95 to blocking@0.9, and only findings in the two HIGH classes (plaintext secrets on boundary-crossing paths, undeclared internet-reachable sensitive surfaces) warrant severity >= major; all other findings remain at most minor.
